title: Power Rankings: Titanic no more? Nets, Raps, Knicks celebrate big week
heading: 2005-06 Power Rankings: Week 10

rankings.summaryHtml: Well ... now we know the team Pistons least want to see in the Finals. A second straight loss to Utah -- yes, Utah -- leaves our trusty No. 1 on a mere 69-13 pace.
rankings.summaryText: Well ... now we know the team Pistons least want to see in the Finals. A second straight loss to Utah -- yes, Utah -- leaves our trusty No. 1 on a mere 69-13 pace.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just a hunch, but I'm guessing Spurs don't mind one bit that their 26 wins (yes, same as Detroit's total) are generating very little attention/scrutiny/hoopla.
rankings.summaryText: Just a hunch, but I'm guessing Spurs don't mind one bit that their 26 wins (yes, same as Detroit's total) are generating very little attention/scrutiny/hoopla.

rankings.summaryHtml: No team has consistently hovered on the heels of the Pistons-Spurs duopoly like Mavs, and here's a big reason why: Dallas is 7-1 in the next game after a loss.
rankings.summaryText: No team has consistently hovered on the heels of the Pistons-Spurs duopoly like Mavs, and here's a big reason why: Dallas is 7-1 in the next game after a loss.

rankings.summaryHtml: The week off figured to help preserve Nets' hold on the coveted No. 4 slot. But they barely held on, even after Vince's buzzer-beater in Toronto. Suns are that hot.

rankings.summaryHtml: Why didn't they think of this sooner? Formal name change from America West Arena to US Airways Center coincides with back-to-back sweep of Heat and then Spurs.

rankings.summaryHtml: My apologies. Grizz have played as though they don't realize Stoudamire's injury is supposed to drop them a notch or two. Until they got to Chicago, anyway.

rankings.summaryHtml: Cavs will miss Hughes, obviously, but probably can scrape by in the short term if LBJ keeps this up: 32.5 ppg, 6.9 rpg, 6.9 apg and 51.4-percent shooting since Dec. 1.

rankings.summaryHtml: If you thought last season was one of a kind, think again: Pacers win a couple without O'Neal and Tinsley as the Artest Watch spills into its second month.
rankings.summaryText: If you thought last season was one of a kind, think again: Pacers win a couple without O'Neal and Tinsley as the Artest Watch spills into its second month.

rankings.summaryHtml: If Riles' goal was shifting the focus off Wade missing a game and an ugly start to a seven-game trip, dropping hints about leaving coaching at season's end did the trick.
rankings.summaryText: If Riles' goal was shifting the focus off Wade missing a game and an ugly start to a seven-game trip, dropping hints about leaving coaching at season's end did the trick.

rankings.summaryHtml: When you've got Milt Palacio, who needs John Stockton? An exaggeration, perhaps, but for one magical overtime in Motown, you couldn't laugh at that question.
rankings.summaryText: When you've got Milt Palacio, who needs John Stockton? An exaggeration, perhaps, but for one magical overtime in Motown, you couldn't laugh at that question.

rankings.summaryHtml: T.J. Ford does everything fast, apparently. And no one's happier to see him back so soon than Redd, who shot 36 percent from the floor in four-plus games without him.
rankings.summaryText: T.J. Ford does everything fast, apparently. And no one's happier to see him back so soon than Redd, who shot 36 percent from the floor in four-plus games without him.

rankings.summaryHtml: Maybe Phil won't have to deal directly with Kobe's fury. Maybe the suspension did it for him, judging by the 98 points of anger No. 8 unleashed on Sixers and Clips.
rankings.summaryText: Maybe Phil won't have to deal directly with Kobe's fury. Maybe the suspension did it for him, judging by the 98 points of anger No. 8 unleashed on Sixers and Clips.

rankings.summaryHtml: Tough for Clips, in the midst of a 3-9 funk, to get too excited about Kaman's surge when the timetable for Maggette's return keeps getting stretched and stretched.

rankings.summaryHtml: The prospect (threat?) of an Artest trade probably is affecting these guys and Denver more than Pacers. Indy, after all, is more accustomed to Artest-related uncertainty.

rankings.summaryHtml: Anyone else out there expecting Melo, who averaged 29.3 ppg in December, to get more All-Star support from the West's coaches than Grizzlies' Gasol?

rankings.summaryHtml: Devastating as his scoring can be, Iverson is still best when he's also a passer. Sixers are 14-8 when AI has at least six assists, 2-9 when he dishes five or fewer.
rankings.summaryText: Devastating as his scoring can be, Iverson is still best when he's also a passer. Sixers are 14-8 when AI has at least six assists, 2-9 when he dishes five or fewer.

rankings.summaryHtml: The present is suddenly painful for Hornets' much-hyped Backcourt of the Future. Paul's out for two weeks, and J.R. Smith has landed in Byron Scott's doghouse.
rankings.summaryText: The present is suddenly painful for Hornets' much-hyped Backcourt of the Future. Paul's out for two weeks, and J.R. Smith has landed in Byron Scott's doghouse.

rankings.summaryHtml: Go ahead and add Wolves to the list of teams affected by Artest speculation. Minny is 3-10 since its five-game win streak and under .500 for the first time since 3-4.
rankings.summaryText: Go ahead and add Wolves to the list of teams affected by Artest speculation. Minny is 3-10 since its five-game win streak and under .500 for the first time since 3-4.

rankings.summaryHtml: Way up here? It's a must when my Raps average 110 ppg in stretching their win streak to five and wipe out two second-half deficits of 10-plus points.

rankings.summaryHtml: Just like their first-round playoff foes from Chicago, Wiz are five games under .500. The difference? One coach (Jordan) is feeling more heat than the other (Skiles).

rankings.summaryHtml: If smallish Bulls can recover from an eight-game skid and a 2-9 rut at home, with their declining defense, it would top last season's resurrection from an 0-9 start.

rankings.summaryHtml: So what can so suddenly make Larry and Steph look (somewhat) harmonious and spark a 3-0 week? Two straight humbling weeks at No. 30, that's what.

rankings.summaryHtml: Celts' defense is getting leakier, and they don't win the close ones: 10 of their 20 losses are by five or fewer points. As a result, fan discontent with Doc is rising.
